messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finserv.com>, Allan Pierce <allan@finserv.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinServCorp

Hi Priya / Allan,

Great to meet you both today — thanks for the time and for walking us through the evaluation priorities. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the demo highlights and share a one-page proposed POC plan so we can align on goals, success criteria, owners, and timeline. Attached is the outline (redwood-poc-outline.pdf).

Demo recap (short):
- Primary use case: real-time customer support summarization and sensitive-data-safe routing to downstream systems.
- Key constraints: 200ms p95 latency target, must support ~10 concurrent requests/sec per model instance during peak, and strict data retention controls (no customer PII stored).
- Must validate cost at scale (target unit cost < $3 / 1k request-equivalent tokens for the hosted trial).

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Success criteria (concrete):
   - Latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token average responses
   - Throughput: sustain 10 req/s with <5% error rate for a 1-hour soak
   - Accuracy: human-eval pass rate >= 85% on your 50-sample prompt set
   - Security: logs/audit verification and encryption-in-transit + at-rest; no message bodies persisted beyond 30 days
2) Evaluation tasks / owners:
   - Redwood: deploy trial model, provide sample prompts, set up telemetry & dashboards (Owner: Rishi Malhotra)
   - FinServCorp: provide redacted sample traffic and top 50 test prompts; designate technical lead for infra access (Owner: Priya Shah)
   - Marissa (me): commercial point, coordinate contract/trial terms and kickoff meetings
3) Timeline (suggested):
   - Week 0: sign trial MSA & data transfer agreement
   - Week 1: trial environment provisioned + initial ingest of sample prompts
   - Week 2: soak test & tuning; run accuracy eval; first results review
   - Week 3: final tuning, cost projection, and success review
4) Next steps:
   - Confirm acceptance of success criteria and timeline
   - Sign attached trial MSA (we can use DocuSign)
   - Schedule 60-min POC kickoff next week (propose Tue 28 Jul, 10:00am PT)

Please see the attached one-pager for a slightly more detailed checklist and telemetry we propose to capture. Happy to iterate — if you want a tighter timeline we can compress Week 1/2 into a single week with a higher-priority onboarding.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinServCorp

Thanks Marissa — very clear and helpful. Priya and I reviewed the one-pager. A few clarifying Qs before we lock timeline: 

1) For the latency target, is the 200ms p95 measured from request arrival at the Redwood API to first token, or to full response completion? For our use case first-token latency is most important.
2) On data retention: we need a 90-day deletion SLA for message bodies in addition to any short-term caching. Can Redwood support that for the trial?
3) On cost: can you provide a rough estimate for the 3-week trial at our expected volume (approx 100k requests total)? Budget owner here is cc'd (Priya).

We're broadly aligned on timeline; Tue 28 Jul at 10:00am PT works for a kickoff as long as we get the trial MSA drafted this week. If you can send the DocuSign version that would speed things up.

On owners: Priya will be the internal tech lead, I'll be the exec sponsor. Rishi — can you confirm who will own the dashboards and access?

Appreciate it,
Allan

--
Allan Pierce
Director, Digital Channels | FinServCorp
allan@finserv.com | +1 (212) 555-0144

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinServCorp

Allan — great questions, thanks. Answers inline and a small revision to the plan below.

1) Latency measurement: we measure p95 to first token by default for streaming endpoints. We'll include both metrics (first-token p95 and end-to-end completion) in the dashboard; success criteria will be verified on first-token p95 unless you prefer otherwise.

2) Data retention: we can support a 90-day deletion SLA for message bodies for this trial. We'll update the trial MSA to reflect 90-day retention and note that KV/prefix caches are ephemeral and will be disabled unless you request caching.

3) Cost estimate: rough order of magnitude for 100k requests (avg 600 tokens/request including prompt + response) = approximately $1,800-$2,400 for the 3-week run on our hosted trial config using quantized model variant (estimate includes request, embedding calls, and telemetry). We'll provide a line-item estimate in the MSA.

Revised quick timeline (we can compress on request):
- Fri 24 Jul: (done) demo + initial proposal
- Tue 28 Jul: kickoff call (10:00am PT) + environment access plan
- Wed 29 Jul: provide sample prompts & redacted traffic (FinServ owner: Priya)
- Week of Aug 3: soak tests and accuracy eval (Redwood owner: Rishi)
- Week of Aug 10: final tuning, cost analysis, and success review

Owners:
- Commercial / contract: Marissa (me)
- Technical onboarding & telemetry: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai)
- FinServ technical lead: Priya Shah (priya.shah@finserv.com)

Next steps for this week:
- I'll send a DocuSign copy of the trial MSA tonight (Neha — can you please attach the 90-day retention clause and the cost estimate table?).
- Priya / Allan: confirm sample data cadence and whether you prefer S3 upload or a secure API endpoint for ingest.
- Confirm Tue 28 Jul 10:00am PT kickoff (calendar invite to follow).

Rishi — can you confirm you'll provision the trial workspace and dashboards once Priya shares the sample prompts?

Thanks,
